title: Chapter 442: Fall Of Sunset City
content:
Chapter 442: Fall Of Sunset City

He immediately called his trusted butler: "If the city is broken later, you take the young lady and go to Wang Shuo immediately."

"Lord!"

Dongfang Ke said no more.

The butler showed a painful expression on his face, sighed, and retreated.

Outside the city.

Rag kicked his limbs and flew above the barrier, and gently touched it with an iron rod.

The barrier that was so solid just now was like a soap bubble, bursting!

Even though Dongfang Ke was prepared, he was still shocked by this change.

A special horn of the demon clan sounded.

"Woo woo woo..."

Countless demons rushed to the top of the city.

On the city wall, various crawling monsters scrambled to climb, and there were various monsters in the air, swooping down on the soldiers in the city.

It can be said that once the barrier was broken, the entire city was basically occupied.

The monsters led by Rag were quite powerful.

In addition, Rag personally rushed to the top of the city, and no one could stop him.

Dongfang Ke was torn to pieces on the spot before he lasted 2 minutes in the hands of Rag.

A year ago, the big boss who could still give orders to the novice trials fell.

After capturing the city, the demons did not massacre.

The demons also need human captives, and many high-level demons like human captives very much.

Whether used for singing and dancing entertainment or for construction and mining, humans are good slaves.

At worst, they can be used as food.

The housekeeper immediately led Dongfang Ling to break through, but unfortunately.

They were not able to escape and were captured by the demons.

A beautiful human woman like Dongfang Ling can still be sold at a good price in the slave market.

Rag was very happy to see that the entire Qingyang City was under control.

But at this time, a demon soldier brought him very bad news.

"My Lord Demon King, Commander Ke, Koba is dead!"

"What?" Rag's voice suddenly dropped a few degrees, and he gently rolled his slender tongue, and the demon soldier was directly rolled into his mouth.

After chewing a few times, he spit it out again.

"Low-end blood tastes too bad."

"Hmph, you have some skills, and you are indeed the one favored by His Majesty the Demon King. I'll let you live a few more days!"

According to Rag's plan, he would first take down Qingyang City and Sunset City, and then attack Dahuai Territory.

Without him doing it himself, this kind of barrier on the city wall would be very time-consuming and laborious to consume.

This is not in the interests of the demon race.

After all, if too many demon soldiers are lost in conquering a piece of land, His Majesty the Demon King will still blame it.

After escorting the captives back to the royal court, Rag immediately led his men and rushed to Sunset City.

At this time, Wang Zhu was standing in the temple, anxiously waiting for the high priest to divine.

Ever since the monsters besieged the city, he had been urging the high priest to divine, wanting to know where the chance of survival was.

But at this time, he had been waiting in the temple for most of the day, and the high priest did not come out.

In desperation, he had to break in.

But on the mat, the high priest had already stopped breathing.

He was bleeding from his mouth and nose, and it seemed that he died from excessive divination.

Wang Zhu slumped on the ground, his eyes slowly losing their spirit.

"Is it really impossible to escape this time?"

For a long time, he relied on the divination of the priest, and he could always choose the best plan.

At this time, the priest died directly, and Wang Zhu was immediately desperate.

The war outside the city continued.

The demon king Rag also quickly came to the outside of the city wall.

Following the same method, Sunset City also fell quickly.
